text:
sam: Deploy-bot kicked off: api@v2.3.0 -> runtime@v1.9.1 -> console@v0.8.5 -> router@v3.2.0. Quiet change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting pins, readiness checks, and rollback criteria from teams.

maria: runtime: confirmed kernel pin v1.9.1. KV-eviction flag is OFF for this rollout. Will watch tail latency for first 10m.

junaid: router: schema change in header handling (x-rdwd-route). We need a hard pin on router + API compatibility mode for 1 hour after traffic shift. Can api enable compat header?

sam: @junaid yes - API will expose compat header via feature flag `rdwd_compat_headers` set to true during shift. After 1h we flip to strict.

deploy-bot: deploy started for api@v2.3.0 (staged). Canary group: 1%. Canary window 10m. Check /health and request traces.

tess: console: no UI schema changes, but console depends on new runtime metrics schema. We'll hold console traffic on stable route until runtime can emit `inflight_ops` metric. ETA 15m post runtime deploy.

kai: ops-sre: setting the cross-service guardrail: if p95 latency for api or router > 600ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, auto rollback api to v2.2.x and pause runtime rollout. Notify #incidents.

maria: runtime can emit `inflight_ops` at +2m after deploy start. Will post a check here when metric available.

sam: release notes: add bullet about header compat flag and runtime KV eviction off. Also mention temporary pin policy and canary % progression. I'll draft and attach after canary.

deploy-bot: api canary reached 1% -> passed health checks. progressing to 10% after 10m.

junaid: router canary ready to accept canary traffic, but keeping pin until API strict mode enabled. Request: don't advance past 50% until runtime `inflight_ops` stable for 5m.

tess: console will remain pinned at 0% for now. I'll do a smoke test once runtime metric shows.

maria: runtime metric `inflight_ops` live at 02:11 UTC. p95 latency 88ms. Good to advance.

sam: advancing api to 10%. Router to 10%. Console remain 0%.

deploy-bot: api at 10% -> health OK. router at 10% -> 2 errors in 2m (header parse).

junaid: seeing header parse errs, rolling router canary back to 0% while we patch the parser to accept compat header. Patch PR #3284.

kai: holding runtime and api progression until router is stable. If router not healthy in 20m we'll rollback api to v2.2.x as per policy.

sam: acknowledged. pausing api >10%. updating release notes: added note about router header regression and temporary pause.

tess: console smoke: no UI issues, waiting on router.

maria: runtime still green, KV cache hit rate stable at 87%. Staging additional logs to help router debug.

junaid: PR merged, deploying router fix to canary. Will watch parser logs.

deploy-bot: router canary redeploy -> 10% -> no new header errors in 6m.

kai: router stable for 6m, p95 120ms. Ops: proceed to 50% but keep api compat flag enabled for 60m after 50% shift.

sam: advancing router to 50% and api to 50%. console to 10% for a quick UI sanity.

deploy-bot: router 50% -> OK. api 50% -> OK. console 10% smoke passed.

maria: runtime observing an increase in long-tail tokens at 75th percentile for a subset of requests. Noting but within SLO.

sam: final plan: after 60m of stable metrics, flip API compat flag off and advance all services to 100%. Rollback criteria reiterated: any p95 breach >600ms for 3m or error rate >1% sustained 3m triggers rollback. Contact list: sam, maria, junaid, tess, kai.

tess: adding a note to release notes about the compatibility flag and router header parser fix. Will publish after final.

deploy-bot: holding until stable window complete. Canary timer 60m started.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll post final release note and closure when we reach 100% or execute rollback. :thumbsup:

maria: ping when you flip the flag, I'll run final regression prompts.

junaid: will keep an eye on header logs.

kai: standing by in #incidents and oncall pager.

deploy-bot: timeline events: started 02:00 UTC, canary -> 02:01, router fix -> 02:18, stability check -> 03:20, final flip scheduled 03:20+60m.
